newsitem.title: INDIA: India Tata Steel 96/97 sales 2.44 mln T.
newsitem.headline: India Tata Steel 96/97 sales 2.44 mln T.

text.p: India's Tata Steel (TISCO) said on Wednesday it sold 2.44 million tonnes of steel in 1996/97 (April-March), up three percent from 2.36 million in the previous year.
The company produced 2.81 million tonnes of saleable steel in 1996/97 against 2.70 million a year earlier, the company said in a statement.
"The production of iron ore sinter in Tata Steel recorded a production of 3.44 million tonnes as against a name plate capacity of less than 2.5 million tonnes," it said.
"This increase in production is almost equal to having an additional million tonne sinter plant without any capital investment."
The increase in iron ore sinter production was made possible by lowering alumina in ore.
Tata Steel produced 3.10 million tonnes of crude steel in 1996/97 compared with 3.02 million in the previous year.
"The saleable steel production during 1996/97 was 2.81 million tonnes out of which HR (hot rolled) coils accounts for 1.04 million tonnes," the statement said.
Tata Steel said cost reduction measures, modernisation, better product mix and improved productivity boosted profitability in 1996/97.
The profit figures for 1996/97 will be announced later, the company said.
